summary.previousEvidence: All nine pages were included in prior contact-sheet visual coverage. New work is finer source-to-current-lesson atomization, not nine previously unseen pages.

findings.finding: ISO numerical grade meaning is not explicitly taught in the current mechanical lessons or weekly items. Existing caution against inferring fit from letter position is correct and should remain.
findings.proposedAction: Add a source-bound short paragraph and independent new practice example comparing grade numbers for the same nominal-size context; do not infer actual limit sizes or fit without tables.

findings.finding: Current lesson covers purpose and unit checks but not the basic extension-line perpendicularity, source reading-direction/above-line placement or angular minutes/seconds.
findings.proposedAction: Small qualified annotation-reading supplement; preserve drawing-wide unit/standard priority.

findings.finding: Current text correctly requires checking surface/axis attachment and datum but describes the exact source attachment examples only generally.
findings.proposedAction: Prepare a new exact original surface/axis/datum comparison diagram and targeted text after technical review; existing15-symbol diagram does not by itself teach these attachment relations.

findings.finding: Diameter/spherical-diameter source rows include greater-than180-degree arc qualifications not stated in the current lesson prose. Existing symbol recognition coverage is not complete coverage of every source-table qualifier.
findings.proposedAction: Retain as a source-bound boundary detail for the next technical/diagram review; do not add an unsupported universal standard rule.
